description: This file defines the SerializationTestEnvironment class used for setting up and managing serialization testing environment within an Orleans-based application. It involves configuration of Orleans client, dependency injection, and exposes properties related to serialization and grain factory functionalities.

classes.name: SerializationTestEnvironment
classes.description: A class that sets up a test environment for serialization in Orleans, managing client creation, service provisioning, and disposal.

methods.name: SerializationTestEnvironment
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Orleans client environment with optional configuration.

methods.name: InitializeWithDefaults
methods.description: Static method to initialize the test environment with default settings and optional client configuration.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the RuntimeClient to clean up resources.
